skills.code:
def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Observe current state
    scene = observe()
    obj = scene["objects"][obj_name]
    zone = scene["zones"][zone_name]

    # Approach from above
    move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obj["top_z"] + 0.1, yaw=obj["short_axis_yaw"])
    open_gripper()
    move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obj["top_z"] - 0.02, yaw=obj["short_axis_yaw"])
    close_gripper()
    wait(20)

    # Check if gripped
    if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to grip the {obj_name}")

    # Lift high enough to clear obstacles
    move_to(obj["center"][0], obj["center"][1], obj["top_z"] + 0.2, yaw=obj["short_axis_yaw"])

    # Move to placement zone and descend to place
    move_to(zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1], zone["center"][2] + 0.1, yaw=obj["short_axis_yaw"])
    move_to(zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1], zone["center"][2] + 0.01, yaw=obj["short_axis_yaw"])
    open_gripper()
    wait(20)
    move_to(zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1], zone["center"][2] + 0.2, yaw=obj["short_axis_yaw"])
skills.expected_effect: object resting inside the zone footprint, gripper open, arm lifted

conditions.notes: The function assumes the object is graspable and the zone is accessible and clear for placement.
